narrative.overview:
NexusMind admin adopts the owner-selected Audit1 Admin visual system: Geist typography, neutral light and dark surfaces, an inset workspace, compact shadcn New York controls, and restrained lime actions. Audit1’s purple brand roles are translated to lime while its neutral material and component geometry remain the reference.

The source authority is Admin-portal-front e9e01b2a and its consumed UI Commons v2.0.670 (47968e54). Local implementation tokens live in src/styles/audit1-theme.css, with compatibility aliases and shell treatments in src/index.css. This system applies to the admin; the landing retains its separately approved identity.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral inset shell with a collapsible sidebar and mobile sheet. Native navigation scrolling stays enabled: hide the scrollbar in the icon rail and use a thin, subdued scrollbar in expanded/mobile navigation, clearer on hover or keyboard focus.
Self-hosted Geist Variable and compact, readable operational hierarchy.
Lime actions with dark ink; independently meaningful semantic statuses.
Thin borders, modest shadows, and subtle workspace grid and radial washes.
Compact neutral count badges with always-visible supporting details. Analytical charts share the Audit1 shadcn/Recharts wrapper and theme-aware lime/slate series.
Categorical metric accents use lime, blue, teal, amber, and rose; semantic status remains independent.

rules.name: The Action Ink Rule
rules.body: Pair solid lime actions with primary foreground. Use the theme-aware brand-link role for readable text emphasis on neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Semantic Pair Rule
rules.body: Choose surface, foreground, border, and focus roles together; theme changes must preserve their relationship.

rules.name: The Geist Interface Rule
rules.body: Use the self-hosted Geist variable family for interface text. Keep the existing monospace stack for code and identifiers.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and shallow shadows for ordinary panels; stronger elevation and scrims belong to overlays.

rules.name: The Data Summary Rule
rules.body: Keep primary counts visible in compact neutral badges. Keep secondary details visible; metrics have no collapse control. Use shadcn chart primitives, real data, and theme-aware series. Do not derive health percentages from overlapping counts. Lay out compact summaries in a container-responsive grid with equal-height cells per row and 8px gaps; six summaries use three columns from 640px and six from 1200px of content width. Keep disabled-account text at normal contrast. Invitation panels retain 16px viewport margins, internal scrolling and readable mobile fields.

rules.name: The Categorical Color Rule
rules.body: Use stable lime, blue, teal, amber, and rose accents for metric categories; keep semantic status colors separate.

dos: Do use primary with primary-foreground for filled lime actions.
Do preserve separate success, warning, error, and information colors with text labels.
Do extend shared shadcn primitives and compatibility wrappers before adding route-specific visual rules.
Do preserve keyboard focus, labels, dialog semantics, permission filtering, and reduced-motion support.
Do preserve real chart data and existing workflow semantics.
donts: Don't restore the obsolete Heebo, black-sidebar, or landing-derived admin system.
Don't use white text or icons on the lime primary fill.
Don't turn every status, panel, or icon into a lime accent.
Don't assume every domain control is Radix or promote an isolated legacy measurement into a global rule.
